import os, subprocess, textwrap
os.makedirs("system", exist_ok=True); os.makedirs("constant", exist_ok=True)

# metres
XS = [0.0, 0.08, 0.12, 0.20]   # duct length 200 mm, block 40 mm centred at 100 mm
YS = [0.0, 0.03]               # duct width 30 mm = block width
ZS = [-0.01, 0.0, 0.03]        # block 10 mm thick below floor; duct height 30 mm

verts = []; vid = {}
def V(i,j,k):
    key=(i,j,k)
    if key not in vid:
        vid[key]=len(verts); verts.append((XS[i],YS[j],ZS[k]))
    return vid[key]

def hexblk(i0,i1,k0,k1,nx,ny,nz):
    v=[V(i0,0,k0),V(i1,0,k0),V(i1,1,k0),V(i0,1,k0),
       V(i0,0,k1),V(i1,0,k1),V(i1,1,k1),V(i0,1,k1)]
    return f"    hex ({' '.join(map(str,v))}) ({nx} {ny} {nz}) simpleGrading (1 1 1)"

NY, NZF, NZS = 6, 6, 2
blocks = [hexblk(0,1,1,2,16,NY,NZF), hexblk(1,2,1,2,8,NY,NZF), hexblk(2,3,1,2,16,NY,NZF),
          hexblk(1,2,0,1,8,NY,NZS)]
print(len(verts)); print("\n".join(blocks))
